name: Monkey D. Luffy
role: A stationary attacker who slingshots a normal-damage Gum-Gum Pistol at a selected enemy along a clear path. Three proposed paths develop Gear 3 impact, Gear 2 attack speed and Gear 4 Python attack tempo. Numbers and prices are proposals, not balance or engine claims.
weakness: Gear 3 attacks more slowly; Gear 2's manual boost has downtime; Python cannot redirect or home its punches. No path grants obstacle bypass, transformation drawbacks, Haki effects or unsupported source abilities.

sourceFacts.quote: In his signature attack, the Gum-Gum Pistol, he slingshots punches at opponents from a distance.
Luffy's signature attack is the Gum-Gum Pistol (ゴムゴムの銃（ピストル）, Gomu Gomu no Pisutoru), a punch which he learned during years of training.

He is able to stretch his entire body; he can stretch his arms to extend the reach of his punches, stretch his legs to extend the reach of his kicks, and stretch his neck to extend the reach of his headbutt.
Gear 3 (ギア3（サード）, Gia Sādo), another technique, involves Luffy blowing air into his thumb bone to inflate it and moving the air around his other bones to inflate other body parts.

Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 3 Techniques: Gear 3 ("Gear Third") is a technique of the Gomu Gomu no Mi wherein the user inflates the bone structure of a body part with air, transforming its size to enhance its strength.

Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 3 Techniques: Gomu Gomu no Gigant Pistol (ゴムゴムの巨人の（ギガント･）銃（ピストル）, Gomu Gomu no Giganto Pistoru?, literally meaning "Rubber Rubber Giant's Pistol/Gun"): The Gear 3 version of Luffy's Gomu Gomu no Pistol technique.
By blowing a massive amount of air into his thumb, Luffy can inflate the bones of a particular part of his body, making it gigantic.

These inflated body parts are capable of inflicting damage on a massive scale, being able to destroy steel doors and large buildings with ease, and Gear 3's power became magnified when Luffy learned to use Armament Haki during the timeskip and Supreme King Haki infusion during the Wano Country Arc.
Initially, Gear 3 would cause Luffy to shrink to the size of a child after its use, temporarily limiting his fighting capabilities until his body returned to normal.

After observing CP9's Shave (剃, Soru) technique,  Luffy develops a technique called Gear 2 (ギア2（セカンド）, Gia Sekando), which increases his strength and speed for a short time by using his body as a pump to move blood at a high speed around his body.
Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 2 Techniques: Gear 2 ("Gear Second") is a technique that uses the power of the Gomu Gomu no Mi to enhance the user's speed and mobility.

Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 2 Techniques: Gomu Gomu no Jet Pistol (ゴムゴムのJET（ジェット）銃（ピストル）, Gomu Gomu no Jetto Pisutoru?, literally meaning "Rubber Rubber Jet Pistol/Gun"): The Gear 2 version of Luffy's Gomu Gomu no Pistol technique.

Luffy throws a punch so fast that the fist's movement is invisible, and it truly seems like he shoots his opponent, except that the resulting impact is not akin to an actual pistol, but to a small hand-held cannon and powerful enough to propel the unlucky recipient several meters away.
The incredible speed both makes the strike far more powerful, and harder to dodge.

Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 2 Techniques: Gomu Gomu no Jet Bazooka (ゴムゴムのJET（ジェット）バズーカ, Gomu Gomu no Jetto Bazūka?, literally meaning "Rubber Rubber Jet Bazooka"): The Gear 2 version of Luffy's Gomu Gomu no Bazooka technique.

Luffy charges at his opponent at high speed and delivers an incredibly fast and strong double open palm strike, having had his arms recoiled from the sudden impact and stopping short of his target in a quasi-horse-stance.
Luffy increases the speed of his blood flow, and thanks to the rubber nature of his blood vessels and organs, his body can withstand the pressure.
Gear 2 greatly increases Luffy's physical capabilities, allowing him to easily surpass the movement speed of Soru users and smash through the defensive power of Tekkai.

Initially, Luffy activated this by pumping blood through his legs to activate the effect across his entire body, but after the timeskip, he has shown to have more control over it and can activate it in any select part of his body.

Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 4 Techniques: Python (大蛇（パイソン）, Paison?, literally meaning "Great Snake/Serpent"): Using a combination of Armament Haki and his rubber body, Luffy is now able to redirect his punches during an attack instead of retracting it back, allowing himself to bypass the necessary build-up time between attacks, making his attacks into semi-homing attacks.
Whilst in Boundman form the attack can continue stretching without losing momentum; in his Snakeman form, the attack goes a step further by continuously accelerating until Luffy retracts it.
The third form, Snakeman, is slimmer and focuses on speed, lacking the defensive capabilities of the other two forms.
Luffy is granted a tremendous increase in attack speed and frequently changes the direction of his attacks to assault his opponents from every direction.

Yet, there not only has been signs of improvement in managing Gear 4's drawbacks and honing its power and abilities with time, but he has also learned to concentrate Gear 4 to certain parts of his body, which results in his limbs enlarging.
This allows Luffy to revert to his usual fighting style of stretching and launching his fists to attack, rather than being constrained to close-range firing.

path1.name: Gear 3 Impact
path1.theme: Choose this path when a slower, weightier punch and bounded impact on nearby enemies are more useful than the base attack's steady single-target output.
path1.rationale: Choose this path when a slower, weightier punch and bounded impact on nearby enemies are more useful than the base attack's steady single-target output.

proposedMechanics.name: Massive-scale impact
proposedMechanics.effect: On a primary hit, the enlarged punch also damages eligible enemies within its bounded splash radius; it does not damage terrain.

path2.name: Gear 2 Jet Pistol
path2.theme: Choose this path for frequent, fast punches and a self-only temporary burst that strengthens the same automatic attack.
path2.rationale: Choose this path for frequent, fast punches and a self-only temporary burst that strengthens the same automatic attack.

proposedMechanics.name: Jet Pistol launch
proposedMechanics.effect: The punch propels its primary target several meters; this proposed launch is not implemented by the supported attack changes.

proposedMechanics.name: Jet Bazooka charge and stance
proposedMechanics.effect: Luffy charges at high speed before delivering the double open-palm strike and stops short in a quasi-horse stance; these actions are not represented by the volley.

path3.name: Gear 4 Python Redirected Punch
path3.theme: Choose this path for improved punch tempo from reduced buildup, then bounded follow-up hits against distinct enemies without changing the player's primary targeting choice.
path3.rationale: Choose this path for improved punch tempo from reduced buildup, then bounded follow-up hits against distinct enemies without changing the player's primary targeting choice.

proposedMechanics.name: Python redirection
proposedMechanics.effect: During an attack, Luffy redirects the stretching punch instead of retracting it, allowing a semi-homing trajectory and bypassing the usual buildup; those trajectory effects are not implemented by the attack-rate change.

proposedMechanics.name: Continuous momentum
proposedMechanics.effect: The stretching attack continues without losing momentum while in Boundman form; the Definition does not represent trajectory momentum.

proposedMechanics.name: Bending trajectory
proposedMechanics.effect: Python bends a punch's trajectory to redirect it during the attack; this supported follow-up does not curve or home and is only a bounded adaptation.

proposals.name: Python homing trajectory
proposals.reason: The Definition cannot curve or redirect a projectile toward enemies. Python purchases retain proposed mechanics for that behavior alongside supported attack-rate or follow-up changes.

reservedTechniques.name: Soru
reservedTechniques.reason: Its disappearing-speed movement is not a supported attack behavior.

reservedTechniques.name: Gomu Gomu no Jet Stamp
reservedTechniques.reason: The supplied passage names the technique but does not describe an enemy effect.

reservedTechniques.name: Hone Fusen
reservedTechniques.reason: Its defensive inflation and projectile ricochet cannot be represented by this attack-focused Definition.

reservedTechniques.name: Gomu Gomu no Rocket
reservedTechniques.reason: Self-launch and unit movement are not supported.

reservedTechniques.name: Gomu Gomu no Gigant Axe
reservedTechniques.reason: This plan adapts Gear 3 through Gigant Pistol; it does not claim the separate axe technique or terrain destruction.

reservedTechniques.name: Kin'niku Fusen
reservedTechniques.reason: Its defensive durability and attack reflection cannot be represented.

reservedTechniques.name: Gear 4 transformation
reservedTechniques.reason: The full transformation, defensive forms and Haki-recharge restriction are outside this plan; Python is adapted separately.

reservedTechniques.name: Supreme King Haki
reservedTechniques.reason: Will-based selective knockout has no matching enemy property.

reservedTechniques.name: Observation Haki
reservedTechniques.reason: Prediction, sensing and dodging are not supported attack mechanics.

reservedTechniques.name: Armament Haki
reservedTechniques.reason: Haki access against intangible targets has no matching property or damage type.

reservedTechniques.name: Gear 5
reservedTechniques.reason: Awakening and environmental rubberization are outside this plan and unsupported.

reservedTechniques.name: Nightmare Luffy
reservedTechniques.reason: Borrowed shadows and their combined skills cannot be represented.
